propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently runs all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time when material fingerprints differ, wasting compute on invalidated Pass-1 checkpoints
The cancel detection must scope to own material only, excluding relation_snapshot and ticket_store_revision, to avoid reintroducing false cancellations on unrelated ticket writes (bug d70a)

A PlanReviewCancelledStale exception raised before coach/verify recovery paths must be checked out-of-band in produce_plan_review_verdict to prevent recovery reconstruction from signing or emitting a sidecar

The own_material_changed probe runs under local_read_context to avoid fetch/reconvergence and sync-lock acquisition, checking only the current ticket's fingerprint at two fixed seams (after finders and after decide)

The cancelled verdict is INDETERMINATE with finding id plan-review-cancelled-stale, unsigned, and unemitted, causing the CLI to exit with code 2 and skipping all downstream floors, signing, and sidecar operations
